4: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveFailureCheck.add("HealUserFullyAndFallAsleep",
5:   proc { |move, user, ai, battle|
6:     next true if !user.battler.canHeal?
7:     next true if user.battler.asleep?
8:     next true if !user.battler.pbCanSleep?(user.battler, false, move.move, true)
9:     next false
10:   }
11: )
12: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("HealUserFullyAndFallAsleep",
13:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
14:     # Consider how much HP will be restored
15:     if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware")
16:       if user.hp >= user.totalhp * 0.5
17:         score -= 10
18:       else
19:         score += 30 * (user.totalhp - user.hp) / user.totalhp   # +15 to +30
20:       end
21:     end
22:     # Check whether an existing status problem will be removed
23:     if user.status != :NONE
24:       score += (user.wants_status_problem?(user.status)) ? -10 : 8
25:     end
26:     # Check if user is happy to be asleep, e.g. can use moves while asleep
27:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill?
28:       score += (user.wants_status_problem?(:SLEEP)) ? 10 : -8
29:     end
30:     next score
31:   }
32: )

135: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectAgainstTargetScore.add("HealUserByTargetAttackLowerTargetAttack1",
136:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
137:     # Check whether lowering the target's Attack will have any impact
138:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill?
139:       score = ai.get_score_for_target_stat_drop(score, target, move.move.statDown)
140:     end
141:     # Healing the user
142:     if target.has_active_ability?(:LIQUIDOOZE)
143:       score -= 20
144:     elsif user.battler.canHeal?
145:       score += 5 if user.has_active_item?(:BIGROOT)
146:       if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware")
147:         # Consider how much HP will be restored
148:         heal_amt = target.rough_stat(:ATTACK)
149:         heal_amt *= 1.3 if user.has_active_item?(:BIGROOT)
150:         heal_amt = [heal_amt, user.totalhp - user.hp].min
151:         if heal_amt > user.totalhp * 0.3   # Only modify the score if it'll heal a decent amount
152:           if user.hp < user.totalhp * 0.5
153:             score += 20 * (user.totalhp - user.hp) / user.totalhp   # +10 to +20
154:           end
155:           score += 20 * heal_amt / user.totalhp   # +6 to +20
156:         end
157:       end
158:     end
159:     next score
160:   }
161: )
